about: Caduceus for OM-3: camera response of the picture-mode sliders, measured on a 24-patch colour checker (2026-11-11, owner's OM-3, 1/40 s f/1.8 ISO 1000, fixed WB). Lab D65 of each patch, median of an 18x18 box on 800x600 copies. No photos.
features: hue+ [12], hue- [12], light [12], sat+ [12], sat- [12], tone [con, hl, sh, mid, blk, wht], wb [a_b, g_m], old-shoot intercept
